title: Trading in residential energy systems with storage: a kinetic mean-field approach
summary: We study a stochastic optimal control problem motivated by the operation of a large ensemble of residential storage devices coordinated by an energy aggregator. The aggregator remunerates prosumers in exchange for direct control of their batteries and seeks to jointly (i) reduce local supply-demand imbalances and (ii) exploit intraday price fluctuations through energy arbitrage.
